posts.title: A playable first-person shooter from one prompt
posts.creator: An Anthropic engineer
posts.blurb: One prompt, then eight hours of the model working on its own. Out came a browser FPS you can actually play. Reported API cost: about $550.

posts.title: 1,000 agents reproduce a formal proof of Fermat's Last Theorem
posts.creator: Anthropic
posts.blurb: A team of a thousand agents worked together, under layered safety controls, to reproduce a machine-checked proof of one of maths' most famous theorems.

posts.title: A full music track, made by driving Ableton
posts.creator: Community build
posts.blurb: A creator connected the model to Ableton Live through MCP, asked for a song, and got a complete arranged track back.

posts.title: A house listing turned into a walkable 3D model
posts.creator: Community build
posts.blurb: Feed it the photos from a Zillow listing and it rebuilds the house as a 3D model you can look around.

posts.title: Manhattan, rebuilt street by street in Unreal Engine
posts.creator: Community build
posts.blurb: A creator had the model reconstruct Manhattan block by block inside Unreal Engine.

posts.title: An old drawing becomes a 3D steam train
posts.creator: Community build
posts.blurb: Starting from an old technical drawing, the model built a full steam locomotive in Blender.

posts.title: 151 live things built with Fable 5.2, all in one list
posts.creator: fengyiqicoder
posts.blurb: Games, 3D worlds and web pages you can open in your browser, plus 111 video demos, each with a preview and a credit to whoever made it. Updated daily.

posts.title: Four Pokémon Red badges on ten tidy notes
posts.creator: Anthropic
posts.blurb: An older model playing Pokémon Red wrote 413 note files and earned one badge. Fable 5 kept just 10 files and earned four. Better notes, not more notes.

posts.title: 4K images and looping GIFs from a text prompt
posts.creator: OpenAI
posts.blurb: Released November 4. People are using it for posters, paper-cut style scenes and short looping animations.

posts.title: An agent that negotiates 2,000 contracts a week
posts.creator: Curative
posts.blurb: A health insurer built a deal-making agent that handles more than 2,000 provider contract negotiations every week to build a national network.

posts.title: An open video model you can download and run
posts.creator: Kandinsky Lab
posts.blurb: Code and weights published under the MIT licence in two sizes, a 29B Pro and a 3B Lite, so anyone can generate video on their own hardware.
